description: Meeting report: who may read, period handling and totals.
precondition: Meetings in a period; reader with report capability.

preconditions: The reader may read meetings spread over January to March 2026 with several statuses and sensitivities.
Ended meetings exist with attendance taken, known start and end times, and issued minutes.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-03".
cases.return: A report From "2026-01" To "2026-03" with GeneratedAt in Vietnam time (+07:00); Total equals the sum of the groups; ByMonth holds every month of the period (months with no meeting show 0); ByStatus holds all 8 statuses in enum order; BySensitivity holds Normal, Internal and Secret; attendance average is a fraction rounded to 4 decimals; duration average is in minutes rounded to 1 decimal; turnaround average is in hours rounded to 2 decimals. No id, title, participant or content of any meeting appears.

preconditions: Only the start month is supplied.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: null.
cases.return: InvalidPeriod; nothing is read and no audit row is written. The endpoint answers 400 MSG463: "Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Chọn tối đa 24 tháng, tháng bắt đầu không sau tháng kết thúc."

preconditions: The database fails while reading the groups.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: ReadFailed; no report. The endpoint answers 500 MSG464: "Không tải được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại."
cases.log: Error: "Could not read the meeting report 2026-01–2026-12" with the database error as cause.

preconditions: Ended meetings exist in the period, but none has attendance taken, none has both start and end times, and none has issued minutes.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: Total counts the meetings; attendance average is null with meetings 0 and meetingsWithoutAttendance equal to the Ended count; duration average is null with meetings 0 and meetingsWithoutTimes equal to the Ended count; turnaround average is null with meetings 0 and meetingsWithoutIssuedMinutes equal to the Ended count.
